name: Acer AR55AR2851UDPRO 55" (SCBC R4, Realtek rtd2851m), India
warnings: No RecoveryActivity in logcat.  setupwraith owns the saved Wi-Fi network on this set (dumpsys wifi | grep -o 'cname=[^ ]*'): leave it enabled.
The remote's YouTube button never reaches Android: com.realtek.keyinterceptserver takes it (keycode 2030) and starts com.google.android.youtube.tv by package, so app_keys cannot remap it.
Not touched: com.apps.factory.ui and com.realtek.factorytools (never started), com.apps.biz.ds and com.apps.biz.mt (unclear), com.seraphic.hbbtv.app, com.apps.usbmediaplayer.
